title: MirageSITL Worker Control Protocol v3 command
description: Equivalent to parseControlCommand in control-v2.ts for protocolVersion 3, except for rules JSON Schema cannot express: the 16 KiB serialized payload limit, the vector norms of EFFECT_CATALOG, the values an intensity scales staying in their envelope, the air density of an atmosphere control, and runtime checks (epoch, deduplication, tick horizon, rotor count, backend support). EFFECT_CATALOG in control-v3.ts states the same ranges, and tests/control-v3.test.ts compares them.
